headline: Umber Components cuts guidance after margin squeeze
body: Umber Components lowered full-year guidance, citing margin pressure from raw material costs and weaker pricing power.

headline: Umber Components announces layoffs affecting 8% of workforce
body: Umber Components said it will cut 8% of its workforce as part of a cost reduction program. Unions criticized the lack of consultation.

headline: Umber Components signs multi-year framework agreement
body: Umber Components announced a framework agreement with a large manufacturer. Terms were not disclosed, and the company expects stable volumes through the contract period.

headline: Umber Components reports minor shipment delays at Leipzig plant
body: Umber Components confirmed shipment delays of several days at its Leipzig plant due to a equipment maintenance backlog. The company said deliveries should normalize within weeks.

headline: Umber Components reports record quarterly revenue

headline: Umber Components appoints new regional sales director
